startup_flow: module/main.module -> module/common.methods -> module/auto/auto.methods -> module/git/git.methods -> module/user/*.module -> module/user/*.packaging.module -> module/base/bash_input.module -> module/learn/learn.methods
service_lifecycle: module/learn/speech_sherpa_onnx_server.py:main -> socket.accept -> play_audio_blocked -> send_server_request_start_record -> AdaptiveGrammarRecognizer.accept_audio -> highlight_diff -> recognition_end
module/learn/speech_sherpa_onnx_client.py:main -> socket.connect -> receive recognition stream -> highlight_diff_multi -> exit on match
networking_flow: module/auto/auto.methods:ftAutoUpload -> dependency checks -> server config lookup -> upload loop
module/auto/auto.methods:ftAutoAdbPush -> ftAdbConnect -> adb push -> optional reboot
user_interaction_flow: module/common.methods:ftEcho / ftInitEcho -> interactive prompts and menus
module/git/git.methods:ftGitLogShell / ftGitPatchAdd2Branches -> log browsing and patch application
